caption: A digital alarm clock is unplugged, and its glowing display goes blank.

sa.check: A digital alarm clock with its display glowing.
Its plug is pulled out of the socket.
A cord runs from the clock to the plug.
The order is glowing, unplugged, blank.

pc.expect: The display goes blank at the moment the plug leaves the socket, and only then.
pc.fail: The plug is out and the digits still glow; or the display goes blank before the plug moves; or it goes blank with the plug still seated and the cord slack.

pc.expect: Once unplugged the display stays blank while the plug is out; digits do not return while no plug sits in a socket.
pc.fail: The digits come back while the plug is out; or the display switches between lit and blank after unplugging; or the display lights up blinking with the plug lying loose.

pc.expect: The clock stays where it sits as the plug is pulled, apart from a tug along the cord; the cord hangs slack once the plug is free.
pc.fail: The clock slides or turns with the cord slack; or the cord stands rigid in the air or floats; or the socket shifts along the wall.

pc.expect: When plugged in again the display lights, blinking or showing a reset time, once the plug seats.
pc.fail: The plug is seated again and the display stays blank to the end of the clip; or the display lights before the plug reaches the socket; or the display comes on and then goes blank again with the plug seated.
pc.precondition: The plug is pushed into a socket again.

pc.expect: One clock, one cord, one plug, one socket; the plug leaves the socket whole and nothing passes through the wall or the table.
pc.fail: The plug vanishes or a second plug appears; or the plug passes through the wall; or the cord splits or detaches from the clock; or the clock changes shape.

pc.expect: The clock's casing colour, its buttons and the surface it sits on stay the same apart from the display.
pc.fail: The casing changes colour; or the buttons rearrange; or the digits change colour or font before going blank.
